name: RimeholtHangingGlacier
intent: A pale blue tongue of glacier ice pouring through a notch in a near-black granite massif, fluted in stepped seracs and crevasses, with a bright meltwater pool and cold-lit cave mouth at its foot, refrozen spikes, and one dense lit fall of meltwater; each seed changes the footprint, notch, tongue length and cave place.
requests: Sculpt kinds cannot hang below their origin, so the meltwater icicles read as refrozen spikes at the ice foot rather than teeth hanging from the lip.

critic_pass1.why: The fluted tongue reads only from the top. Every close shot is a dark mass with no lit subject, and the drip is barely visible.

critic_pass2.best_shot: shots seed 1 in along the road
critic_pass2.why: The tongue now reads as one teal mass of fluted seracs against the dark granite, where before it was a grey-on-grey wall, and the road shots exist, but from above it is a rectangular slab of columns, the meltwater fall is invisible in the set piece, and the seeds barely change.
